Common 404 errors:
- Library ID not in known-mcp-servers.json.
- Provider missing from McpProviderConfigurationFactory switch statement.

409 Conflict error codes (in `ProblemDetails.Extensions["errorCode"]`):
- `TenantAlreadyExists` — a Tenant-level configuration already exists for this library.
- `PersonalConfigCannotCoexistWithTenant` — saving a Personal ApiKey while a Tenant ApiKey
  already exists for this library is rejected (ApiKey XOR rule). Frontend may pre-flight via
  `GET configuration/status?authType=ApiKey`.
- `TenantConfigCannotCoexistWithPersonal` — saving a Tenant ApiKey while any Personal ApiKey
  already exists for this library is rejected (ApiKey XOR rule). The Personal→Tenant promote path
  excludes the user's own row from the check so promotion of an existing Personal is allowed.
- `Gateway.ConfigurationAuthTypeConflict`: a no-id save would replace a Tenant row whose
  auth type differs. The body names `existingConfigurationId` and `existingAuthType`.
  A replace sends that id.
- `Gateway.ConfigurationConcurrentModification`: that same no-id Tenant save lost the
  compare and the stored auth type is not a different type. The body may name
  `existingConfigurationId`. It does not name `existingAuthType`. Reload and retry.

post.description:
Called by the deployment form's "Connect to {Provider}" handler immediately before
kicking off the primary OAuth redirect. The endpoint creates a UCS static credential
for the supplied token and returns the binder id, which the frontend stashes in form
state and includes on the eventual deployment save as SchemaCredentialBinderId.
By the time the OAuth callback completes and the frontend asks for tools, both
credentials exist in UCS, so the gateway's session-init can fetch the spec on the
very first attempt — sidestepping the chicken-and-egg between binder creation and
tool listing that would otherwise force a special-case create-then-edit UX.
        Validation rules (all 400):
    * Library not found → 404.
* Library is a custom server → 400 (schema credentials are seed-driven only).
* Library does not declare SchemaCredentialProviderName → 400.
* Request Provider does not match the seed-declared provider → 400.
* Empty token → 400.
* Caller lacks MCP Gateway manage → 403 OwnershipRequired.

Gets or sets how to read IReadOnlyList<AuxiliaryGatewayInventoryToolResponse> AuxiliaryGatewayInventoryAppResponse.Tools. One of
AuxiliaryGatewayInventoryToolListings.

tools.description:
Gets or sets the tools this gateway includes for this app. Never the app's full catalog
(PRD D2). Read it together with string AuxiliaryGatewayInventoryAppResponse.ToolListing, under which an empty array
means "not knowable here" (`all_not_enumerable`), "the gateway observed none"
(`all`, reachable only from a stamped authoritative-empty snapshot), or "the admin

oneOf.description:

string AuxiliaryGatewayInventoryAppResponse.SkillListing, under which an empty array means three different things:

radarEnabled.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the gateway is surfaced through Radar in the UI.

allowedToolsAll.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether the gateway includes every tool its apps serve. When
true, every app's tool listing is one of the `all` forms.

instructions.description:
Gets or sets the gateway-wide markdown instructions, or null. Admin-authored guidance text,
rendered as an input on the Gateway Settings panel (PRD A3).

instructionsToolDescription.description: Gets or sets the custom description for the instructions tool, or null for the default.

updatedAt.description: Gets or sets when the gateway was last changed.

apps.description: Gets or sets the applications included in the gateway, in the stored order.

AuxiliaryGatewayInventoryDetailResponse.description:
The MCP Gateway Inventory read of one auxiliary gateway (MCPG-1880): the stored configuration
the read-only detail view renders (PRD section 6). It carries the gateway settings, its
applications, and per application only the tools and skills that gateway includes (PRD D2), with
enabled state (PRD D5). It never carries credential material, a connection state, or a
per-connection identifier: the gateway's `SharedCredentials` binding map is not even loaded
on this path. `AuxiliaryGatewayInventoryContractTests` pins the whole graph, so adding a
property here means updating that allowlist in the same PR, under review.

groupMembershipDegraded.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether the filtered user's group membership could not be
resolved (MCPG-2221). Set only when a `userId` filter was supplied. When true the page
still answers, but only through the owner, unrestricted and direct-assignment arms of the
reachability rule: a gateway that user reaches through a group alone may be missing.
Mirrors bool DynamicGatewayInventoryResponse.GroupMembershipDegraded.

items.description: Gets or sets the items in the current page.

totalCount.description: Gets or sets the total count of items across all pages.

pageNumber.description: Gets or sets the current page number (1-based).

pageSize.description: Gets or sets the number of items per page.

hasMore.description: Gets a value indicating whether there are more pages available.

totalPages.description: Gets the total number of pages.

AuxiliaryGatewayInventoryListResponse.description:
One page of the Auxiliary Gateway listing (MCPG-1879), plus the one page-level fact the
`userId` filter can add: whether the group half of that user's reachability could be
resolved. `GatewayInventoryListContractTests` pins this envelope from its root, so adding
a property here means updating that allowlist under review.

isStamped.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether the snapshot entry carries the complete MCPG-1832
stamp. When false, every nullable property here is null and the rows cannot be dated;
bool AuxiliaryGatewayInventoryProvenanceResponse.RevisionIsDerived is not nullable and is simply false, since there is no
revision for it to qualify.

catalogVersion.description: Gets or sets the content-derived catalog version of the observation, or null when unstamped.

sourceRevision.description:
Gets or sets the source revision of the observation, or null when unstamped. Qualify it with
bool AuxiliaryGatewayInventoryProvenanceResponse.RevisionIsDerived before treating it as one the source itself reported.

sourceCoordinate.description:
Gets or sets the exact coordinate the observation was taken from, or null when unstamped.
This is what goes stale when an app is repointed: rows taken from a coordinate the app no
longer serves are the case this whole type exists to make visible.

catalogGeneration.description: Gets or sets the catalog generation the observation matched, or null when unstamped.

revisionIsDerived.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether string? AuxiliaryGatewayInventoryProvenanceResponse.SourceRevision was derived rather than
reported by the source.

AuxiliaryGatewayInventoryProvenanceRespo.description: Where a stored list came from, so an auditor can tell a current observation from a stale one.

gatewayId.description: Gets or sets the gateway identifier.

name.description: Gets or sets the gateway name.

scope.description: Gets or sets the gateway's scope: Tenant or Personal.

ownerUserId.description:
Gets or sets the identifier of the user who owns the gateway. An identifier rather than a
display name on purpose: the gateway has no user directory — Platform's
`InternalUserService` exposes group membership and nothing else — so identity is
resolved by the frontend, exactly as it already is for the assignment lists below.

assignedGroupIds.description:

IReadOnlyList<Guid>? AuxiliaryGatewayInventoryResponse.AssignedUserIds.

clients.description: Gets or sets the clients the gateway has been reached through, most recently seen first.

AuxiliaryGatewayInventoryResponse.description:
One Auxiliary Gateway row on the MCP Gateway Inventory list page (MCPG-1879). Configuration and
reachability only: no credential material, no connection state, no tool bytes.

url.description: Gets or sets the skill URL, which is its identity in the SEP-2640 index.

name.description:
Gets or sets the skill display name, falling back to the url when the stored inventory
carries no name. Never identity: a name is display-derived and not unique across an index
(MCPG-2072 S3).

description.description:
Gets or sets the skill description as the gateway observed it, or null when the stored
inventory carries none. PRD A5 asks the detail page to show skills with their descriptions.

enabled.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether the skill is enabled in this gateway. True for every
row, for the same reason as the tool sibling.

AuxiliaryGatewayInventorySkillResponse.description:
One skill the gateway includes for an app, drawn from the gateway's own stored selection
(`AllowedSkillsByLibrary`) and described from the inventory it observed at save time
(`StoredSkillDefinitions`), both added by MCPG-2072. No upstream is contacted, so PRD D2
holds. Read the rows through the app's `skillListing`, which says whether they are the
admin's selection, everything the gateway observed, or a set it cannot enumerate.

name.description: Gets or sets the upstream tool name.

enabled.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether the tool is enabled in this gateway. True for every
row today, by construction: PRD D2 lists only the included set, so an excluded tool has no
row rather than a row with a false. The field is here because the read-only page renders a
greyed-out toggle whose position must be real (PRD D5), and because a future selection shape
that carries a per-tool disable would otherwise be invisible.

AuxiliaryGatewayInventoryToolResponse.description: One tool the gateway includes for an app.

as `runId`. A POST that omits it starts a different run.

this run covered the remaining list. Resume by passing

providerRows.description: Gets the number of provider-configuration rows in the caller tenant.

customServers.description: Gets the number of custom servers in the caller tenant.

gatewayApps.description: Gets the number of shared-credential entries on live gateways in the caller tenant.

dashboardPreferences.description: Gets the number of dashboard library preferences in the caller tenant.

legitimate.description:
Gets the legitimate-null count: credentialless provider rows, credentialless custom
servers, and every dashboard preference.

unconfigured.description:
Gets the unconfigured-null count: credential-requiring provider rows and custom servers
that store no credential handle, plus a gateway library with no entry that links no
eligible Tenant binder and no anchored Personal binder. Reported by count. Does not
block cutover. An omitted or faulted handle is not counted here.

Gets the unmigrated count: shared-credential values that are still row ids, personal
pointers, or deleted ids, plus a gateway library with no entry that already has an
eligible Tenant binder or an anchored Personal binder, or whose handle could not be
classified. A value that is already a binder id is not included.

absentEntries.description:
Gets live-gateway libraries with no shared-credential entry whose absence is unmigrated.
Those entries are included in int CredentialCensusCounts.Unmigrated.

counts.description: Gets the tenant-wide family counts. These are aggregates, not a walk of every handle.

items.description: Gets the rows on this page.

kind.description: Gets the family: provider_row, custom_server, gateway_app, or dashboard_preference.

credential id that resolved to a different binder. Null is none.

did not resolve. Null when the row has no level or the binder level is unknown.

by another user was omitted by the store, so the census does not call it missing.

eligible.description:

tenant_authorization_code, v1_credential_id, or level_mismatch.

pending.description:
Gets the number of rows that still needed a typed column or a disagreement repair when
the run started.

written.description: Gets the number of both-null rows the run wrote a typed column onto.

repaired.description:
Gets the number of disagreement rows the run rewrote to the UCS-classified family,
clearing the wrong family's column, or typed-only residue it repaired to cleared.

noHandle.description:
Gets the number of pending rows skipped because they had no legacy handle after
typed-only residue was repaired. Those rows stay pending; they hold the flag-ramp.

unclassified.description:
Gets the number of rows whose legacy id UCS did not positively classify, including
batch-resolve and provider-read faults. Those rows stay pending; they hold the flag-ramp.

familyDisagreement.description:
Gets the number of rows whose UCS-classified family conflicts with
`AuthenticationType`. Those rows stay pending; they hold the flag-ramp.

personalBinder.description:
Gets the number of rows skipped because a personal OAuth binder for the server equals the classified id.
The static column is not written.

Gets the number of working legacy rows skipped because `AuthenticationType` is
None or unset, including when UCS cannot classify the handle. The run leaves the handle
on the legacy column; flag-on hydration still serves it through the both-typed-null
fallback, so this count does not hold the flag-ramp.

v1Origin.description:
Gets the number of rows whose legacy id is a live V1 credential. The run leaves
`CredentialBinderId` null and keeps the legacy handle; flag-on hydration still
serves that handle through the both-typed-null fallback, so this count does not
hold the flag-ramp.

truncated.description:
Gets a value indicating whether the run stopped on its iteration guard rather than because
there was nothing left. A true here means run it again, and look at why rows are not settling.

Radar's indexer opts in by sending `true` so `radar_search`
continues to surface reconnect affordances (MCPG-809 / MCPG-964). Always honored
(MCPG-2123 baked credential recovery). Nullable to make
the omitted-means-off contract explicit on the wire (avoids value-type under-posting).

forceRefresh.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether this user's cached tool catalog is discarded
before discovery runs. Optional; an absent value (the common case) is treated as
`false` and preserves today's behavior of serving whatever snapshot
the Redis cache holds. The Airia Platform tool pane sets it only on the manual refresh
button, which re-issues this same POST and was previously a silent no-op because the
retry hit the same cache entry, so an agent added after the snapshot stayed invisible
for the full 10-minute TTL (MCPG-1669). Invalidation is one pass over the caller's
whole `tools:{userId}:` prefix, not just the libraries named in this request, so
the caller's other cached libraries re-probe lazily on next view; no other user is
ever disturbed.
A force-refresh names at most `SpecSourceRefresh:MaxRequestedLibraryIds`
libraries (default 200) and re-pins at most
`SpecSourceRefresh:MaxLibrariesPerRequest` SpecLink or SkillLink rows
(default 8); more is 400. Ordinary reads stay uncapped. The re-pin
write is rate-limited per tenant and user and has an overall deadline; rows
not reached keep the previous pin and report `sourceRefreshError`.
Nullable to make the omitted-means-off contract explicit on the wire (avoids value-type
under-posting).

Coarse outcome of an MCP server's connection state — the FE-aligned ubiquitous
            language used end-to-end across BE and FE to drive UI affordances.

setup, or reconnect can clear this classification. Present as
`true` only for `not_configured`,
`awaiting_credentials`, `credential_invalid`, and
`misconfigured` when the primary credential of an interactive
personal-OAuth source is the cause. Absent (`null`) for
non-interactive sources, Connected results, and reasons a primary
connect cannot clear. Never `false`.

oneOf.description:
Gets the recovery action for this classification. Null on an unstamped
singleton (omitted from JSON and gRPC). A stamped wire state always
carries a value other than RecoveryCommand.Unspecified.
Absent means the client keeps today's derivation. Present is authoritative
and replaces reading string? McpConnectionState.Reason to choose Connect, Reconnect,
Configure, or Save credential.

McpConnectionState.description:
State-only view of an MCP server connection — the wire-shape primitive that
            every transport (REST, gRPC, SignalR push, future Orleans grain messages)
            can carry without dragging the entire `McpServerConfiguration`
            along. The build-outcome wrapper `McpConnectionResult` composes a
            state with the optional built configuration.
            Shape contract:* McpConnectionOutcome McpConnectionState.Outcome is always set.
* string? McpConnectionState.Reason is set when
                McpConnectionOutcome McpConnectionState.Outcome is McpConnectionOutcome.Error (from
                McpConnectionReasons), when McpConnectionOutcome McpConnectionState.Outcome is
                McpConnectionOutcome.Connected and the value is
                string McpConnectionReasons.RefreshPending, or when
                McpConnectionOutcome McpConnectionState.Outcome is McpConnectionOutcome.NeedsSetup
                and the value is
                string McpConnectionReasons.SchemaCredentialNotConfigured. Other
                Connected and NeedsSetup results keep string? McpConnectionState.Reason null.
                Unknown non-error reasons are informational and never a gate.
* string? McpConnectionState.ReasonDetails is an optional human-readable refinement
                (UCS error code, exception message) intended for logs and developer-facing
                diagnostics — not for end-user UI strings.
* Exception? McpConnectionState.Error is the original exception when the outcome was
                caused by one. Internal use only — never serialized.
* bool McpConnectionState.Disabled is an orthogonal admin-disable flag — it can
                be true alongside any McpConnectionOutcome McpConnectionState.Outcome (a Connected or NeedsAuth
                server can still be admin-disabled), so it does not collapse into the
                readiness outcome.
* bool? McpConnectionState.InteractiveAvailable is present (`true`)
                only for a user-recoverable classification of an interactive personal-OAuth
                source. It is omitted (`null`) otherwise and is never
                `false`.
* RecoveryCommand? McpConnectionState.RecoveryCommand is the recovery action. It is omitted
                (`null`) on an unstamped singleton so an old payload stays
                absent. A present value is authoritative. RecoveryCommand.Unspecified
                is never stored.

Gets or sets the redirect URL where the user should be sent after OAuth completion.

credentialProviderConfigId.description:
Gets or sets the UCS OAuth Provider Configuration ID to use for this redirect.
When provided, overrides the CredentialProviderConfigId stored on the Gateway
ProviderConfiguration. This supports scenarios where multiple OAuth apps exist
for the same library and the caller needs to target a specific one.

replaceExistingConfig.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether the existing DCR registration should be
    replaced with a fresh one for DCR-style providers. When `true` and the integration
    already has a `CredentialProviderConfigId`, the redirect flow skips the
    "reuse existing DCR" branch and falls through to fresh DCR registration. The
    existing name-collision recovery (PersonalNameAlreadyExists / TenantNameAlreadyExists)
    then retires the stale UCS provider configuration before re-registering, which is
    the equivalent of a Disconnect + Reconnect performed in a single click.
    Recovery affordance for the case where an upstream OAuth provider has rotated or
invalidated a DCR client registration server-side (e.g., Atlassian's hosted MCP):
the stored CredentialProviderConfigId is still present in UCS but its
underlying client_id no longer authenticates, so a standard "reuse" reconnect
is doomed to fail. Setting this flag forces the gateway to issue a new registration.
    Has no effect for Manual OAuth integrations (the user-managed
RemoteManualOAuthConfiguration), since the OAuth client is owned by the user
and cannot be auto-rotated. Has no effect when no existing integration is present
(fresh DCR is already the default in that branch).
    Nullable to defend against under-posting: an absent value is treated as
false (the safe default), distinguishable from an explicit false in
future behavior if needed.

uriVariableValues.description:
Gets or sets personal URI variable values supplied with a reauthenticate
(bool? OAuthRedirectRequest.ReplaceExistingConfig). A personal key here replaces the stored
value on the new DCR row. Shared keys are left on the stored row.

scopes.description:
Gets or sets the scopes to request instead of the stored Manual OAuth scopes (MCPG-2016). Lets
the scopes editor try an unsaved list. Honoured only when bool? OAuthRedirectRequest.ValidateOnly is set: an
ordinary connect always uses the saved row, so a caller cannot widen an admin-saved scope set.
Ignored when null or empty.

validateOnly.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether this redirect is a validate-only consent (MCPG-2016):
the provider's consent screen is the scope check, and on success the callback deliberately does
not exchange the authorization code, so no credential is stored and the current connection is
untouched. Requires a saved Manual OAuth configuration with an interactive grant.

OIDCClientRepresentation.description:
Represents an OIDC client representation for dynamic client registration in Keycloak.

This class is based on the Keycloak OIDCClientRepresentation Java class structure
from Keycloak version 26.0.8 documentation:
https://www.keycloak.org/docs-api/26.0.8/javadocs/org/keycloak/representations/oidc/OIDCClientRepresentation.html

Note: This implementation is compatible with Keycloak v26.0.6 and is used for
POST requests to /realms/{realm}/clients-registrations/openid-connect endpoint.

Reference: OpenID Connect Dynamic Client Registration 1.0 specification.
